findings.claim: Legacy-layout obs reads still cost 3 Files.exists probes plus a failed stat at the current location, 6 filesystem operations in total, which is the same as master. So TRUNK-6682's 'at most one existence-related check' holds only for new-layout keys. This is a reply in the existing unanswered thread 4070873940 (filed on AbstractHandlerTest), which asks whether the ticket stays open for the layout-resolution half.
findings.evidence: Throwaway test (since deleted) read obs through TextHandler.getObs(TEXT_VIEW) on LocalStorageService with complex_obs dir GP 'complex_obs'. The legacy file was <appdata>/complex_obs/note_abc123.txt with valueComplex 'note file|note_abc123.txt'. HEAD: I counted fileExists by overriding it and counted reads with temporary counters in read(). New layout: fileExists=1, reads=1, failedReads=0 (positive control, matches the PR's claim). Legacy: fileExists=3, reads=2, failedReads=1. BASE (worktree at a93b6293c9, Files.exists/newInputStream/readAttributes wrapped in counters): new layout exists=4 open=1 stat=1, legacy exists=4 open=1 stat=1. The 3 probes at head: exists() checks the current path and then the raw legacy path (LocalStorageService.java:278-294); read() fails at the current path and checks the legacy path again (LocalStorageService.java:96-112). The independent subagent reproduced fileExists=3 for both 'legacy.txt|legacy.txt' and 'legacy.txt|complex_obs/legacy.txt'. The legacy shape (catch the miss in AbstractHandler and retry with the prefix) was rejected in thread 3990841768 because it changes parseDataKey's public return value and can't be backported, so this is a question about ticket scope, not a request to redo that design.

findings.claim: This PR adds a behaviour change with no test: a read failure other than NoSuchFileException now throws APIException from TextHandler (TEXT/RAW view) and BinaryDataHandler.java:74. Master logged it and then failed on Assert.notNull with IllegalArgumentException('Complex data must not be null'). Nothing pins the new throw, so it can regress silently.
findings.evidence: Mutation probe: deleting both `throw new APIException(...)` lines (TextHandler.java:96, BinaryDataHandler.java:74) leaves TextHandlerTest (6), BinaryDataHandlerTest (6) and AbstractHandlerTest (4) green: `mvn -o -B -pl api -am test -Dtest='TextHandlerTest,BinaryDataHandlerTest,AbstractHandlerTest'` gave BUILD SUCCESS, 16 tests, 0 failures. Files restored afterwards. The subagent reproduced the base/head difference with a key that resolves to a directory ('Is a directory'): base threw IllegalArgumentException, head throws APIException for Text RAW, Text TEXT and BinaryData RAW. The change itself is what ibacher asked for (thread 3990887402), so the ask is only a test, for example a StorageService stub whose getDataWithMetadata throws a plain IOException, asserting APIException.

verdict: Close to mergeable: every prior-round finding I re-checked is fixed at the head, and nothing blocks. The open item is whether TRUNK-6682 can close while legacy-layout reads still make 3 existence probes (F1), which is a ticket-scope decision for the maintainers.
what_i_swept: Confirmed the diff stat (21 files, +967/-68; three-dot and two-dot diffs identical, so the branch is not behind base). Read the ticket, the PR body and all 31 inline comments, 11 reviews and 13 PR comments. Re-checked each prior thread against the head: the S3 getData delegation, the multipart length fix and its mocked test, exists() containment (including the new e3 test), the FileSystemException fallback, the long-name legacy test with tempDir/obs created, the ImageHandler legacy filename fallback with a single exit, the leftover obsDir variable, the restored AbstractHandler call-count test, the deprecated 2-arg injectMissingMetadata, @since 3.0.0 on the new API, NoSuchFileException documented on StorageService, the default getDataWithMetadata closing the stream on failure, URI_VIEW metadata, and DataWithMetadata as a normally formatted class. Ran a mutation probe on the last round's ask: making LocalStorageService.getDataWithMetadata skip read()'s legacy fallback turns the new getDataWithMetadata_shouldReturnDataAndMetadataWhenLegacyFileExists red, so that fix is real. Step 2: measured new-layout vs legacy-layout filesystem op counts at base and head through a real handler. The new-layout path drops from 6 to 3 ops (4 exists + open + stat down to 1 exists + stat + open), which resolves the ticket's main complaint. Legacy stays at 6. Traced outward: every StorageService implementation in the tree (only Local and S3, both via BaseStorageService), the remaining getPath() callers (purgeData only), all handlers that call the new API, and the AbstractHandler subclasses. Convention checks: master already uses records and pattern-matching instanceof (AuthorizationAdvice, LayoutTemplate, UserContext), so their use here is not a backport finding. Backport @since tags are added after the backports merge (e72a818d0), so @since 3.0.0 alone is the project's practice. Security: path containment for ../, absolute and outside keys (the subagent found base and head identical). Performance is the subject of the PR and was measured above. S3 at runtime: `mvn -o -pl api -am test -Pintegration-test -Dtest=S3StorageServiceIT` ran against an S3Mock 4.5.0 container: 28 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. Control: replacing translateNotFound in S3StorageService.getDataWithMetadata with a plain rethrow turned the inherited getDataWithMetadata_shouldThrowNoSuchFileExceptionWhenFileDoesNotExist red (1 failure). S3StorageServiceTest: 3 tests pass. Deprecation: javac -Xlint:deprecation against api/target/classes emits '[deprecation] injectMissingMetadata(String,ComplexData) in AbstractHandler has been deprecated' for a subclass overriding the 2-arg method. Control: overriding the 3-arg method compiles with no warning. So the deprecation agreed in thread 4512249216 does flag module overrides at compile time.

subagents.purpose: The skill's independent second reviewer, given only the PR, the ticket and build instructions (not my findings), to find defects provable by running base against head.
subagents.what_it_reported: (1) A module override of the 2-arg injectMissingMetadata no longer runs: reproduced, but already raised in thread 4512249216 and closed with the deprecation the reviewer asked for, so not re-filed. (2) A third-party StorageService that signals a missing key with something other than NoSuchFileException now gets APIException instead of IllegalArgumentException in Text, BinaryData and BinaryStream; not filed, since both are exceptions and the PR documents the NoSuchFileException contract. (3) Other read errors switch from IllegalArgumentException to APIException: deliberate per ibacher, filed as the missing-test suggestion F2 after my mutation probe. (4) When a key exists in both layouts, read() now returns the current copy while purgeData still deletes the legacy copy: reproduced by the subagent, but it needs an extension-less name in both directories, which no current write path produces, so I judged it not worth filing. (5) Legacy-layout reads still make 3 existence checks: matches my own base and head measurement (F1). It also listed many paths it found identical at base and head: missing-file behaviour in all six handlers, legacy/new data, mime type and length, containment, and exists() results.

notes: This is a re-review on a long-running PR. Every prior thread I checked is resolved at 86b96c7d6, and by the skill's rule those earn silence. The last round's single ask (the legacy getDataWithMetadata test) was added in cdbc3b108, and I proved with a mutation that it catches the regression. The PR description's 'previously cost 5 filesystem operations' is slightly off: I measured 6 on base (4 Files.exists + stat + open) for a new-layout read. Its 'now 3' claim is accurate for new-layout keys only. A mistake of mine during the review: my first throwaway run wrote a Maven log to /tmp/claude-501 (outside the allowed area). I deleted it at once and kept every later log inside the working copy, deleting each after use. The working copy is clean (`git status --porcelain` shows only ?? .mvn/maven.config) and the temporary base worktree has been removed. Correction: an earlier draft listed the S3 runtime path as unverifiable because 'Docker is not available'. That was an unchecked assumption. Docker was reachable and had the adobe/s3mock:4.5.0 image locally, and the S3 IT was then run with a mutation control (see what_i_swept). Both earlier could_not_verify items are now verified.
